activity_summary: You came onto the grass at the town end of the bridge with the three. The book was already off the grass. Nothing had been cut.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Cut the three hulls, and gave the only answer he had.

entities.name: Susanna Shakespeare
entities.context: Kept the book dry, read the wall, and asked about the door.

entities.name: Judith Shakespeare
entities.context: Named hers after the ballad, and kept the words.

entities.name: Golding's Ovid
entities.context: Mentioned in Came onto the grass by the bridge

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: The grass, and not a step further into the afternoon than the grass.
